title: Qatar's Dandy prices IPO at $1.37 per share
summary: The IPO is expected to raise around QAR 206 million before fees

The IPO is expected to raise around QAR 206 million before fees

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Dandy, the Qatari producer of dairy, drinks and ice cream, has priced its IPO on the Qatari Stock Exchange (QSE) at QAR 5 per share ($1.37).
